title: Could find WAY better thermometers for slightly more money!
text: Could find WAY better thermometers for slightly more money!. The magnet is trash!  Doesn't hold the weight of the thermometer.  Out the box the temperature reading was low & needed to be recalibrated.  My overall assessment is that this is it cheaply made thermometer.

product_metadata.title: Digital Meat Thermometer, 2-in-1 Waterproof Instant Read Food Thermometer, with Foldable Probe & Oven Safe Wired Probe, Backlight Alarm Function, for Oven, Smoker, Grill, BBQ, Baking, and Turkey
